reason: Raises the published engines.node floor from >=24.19.0 to >=24.21.0. Narrowing the supported runtime range is a consumer-compatibility change, so it takes a minor under the project cadence, as v0.18.0 and v0.19.0 did when they moved the floor. The toolchain pins the same version across ci.yml, release.yml, docker/test.Dockerfile and .nvmrc, and tests/docker.test.js requires the published floor to be a runtime the gates actually ran on. Installs on Node 24.19 or 24.20 will surface an npm engines warning until they upgrade.
